diagnosis: The artifact's local replacement operators remain above the locked local cosine floor, but their sequential composition does not preserve the native source trajectory. A large global drop appears at layer 29 and persists through the output. Very high common-logit cosine still changes 3 of 28 first-token argmaxes, establishing downstream decision sensitivity. The autonomous failure is therefore ABI extraction/composition quality, not the construct-certified LayerCake fp16 host.
decision: Close local-only routed-v15 extraction. Authorize one no-training feasibility audit for an in-budget late global-state anchor that reuses existing layer-29/layer-31 parameter slots and measures train-derived rank energy plus held-out global correction before any successor artifact is written.
claim_boundary: Read-only failure attribution only; no new artifact, quality promotion, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
